note: Receipt of Microsoft Clarity project decisions, keyed by the Site Health catalog id. One Clarity project per product: an ID recorded against two products merges their sessions and cannot be unmerged afterwards. This file records only decisions that have actually been made; it is deliberately not a copy of the private 56-entry catalog, and a catalog entry that is absent here simply has no Clarity decision yet. Verify with: node scripts/clarity-audit.mjs --check
